A sovereign digital commerce stack is a self-contained architecture that enables digital creators to sell their products without relying on third-party payment processors like PayPal or Stripe. This means that you, as a creator, own the entire infrastructure and can deploy it anywhere in the world, without worrying about platform fees or restrictions. It's not a workaround, but a base-layer solution that gives you complete control over your digital commerce operations.

The architecture consists of a combination of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. You can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery.
